inputGenerator:
import random

seed = int(input())
r = random.Random(seed)
opens = "([{<"
closes = ")]}>"
mode = r.randint(0, 2)
if mode == 0:
    n = r.randint(1, 10)
    print("".join(r.choice(opens + closes) for _ in range(n)))
else:
    k = r.randint(1, 5)
    out = []
    st = []
    opened = 0
    while opened < k or st:
        if opened < k and (not st or r.random() < 0.5):
            t = r.randrange(4)
            out.append(opens[t])
            st.append(t)
            opened += 1
        else:
            out.append(closes[st.pop()])
    if mode == 2:
        j = r.randrange(len(out))
        out[j] = r.choice(opens + closes)
    print("".join(out))
